before.title: Document explicit local Core and beta installations
before.body:
The Core starter already writes the creating executable’s absolute path into its README, but the guide still told users to replace a bare `mori` command. Update that guidance and give the Node beta guide an explicit local package installation and executable selection recipe.

Preserves the existing profile walkthrough and keeps Rust Core separate from the Node beta’s Source/6 preparation. Stacked on the header diagnostic repair in PR244.

Validation: 45 source pins, 31 relative links and 11 shell syntax blocks checked; patch and whitespace checks passed. A fresh installation, build and the documented runtime examples were not run. Independent source/static-result review is pending.

actualReplacement.title: Document explicit local Rust and Node installations
actualReplacement.body:
Clarify how to install and invoke the Rust Core tools and the separate Node beta package. The documentation uses an explicit Rust executable and an absolute installed Node entrypoint, and preserves the current profile walkthrough.

This contains only the two documentation changes from PR246. Its older financial-prefix ancestry is excluded; that work remains separate.

Fresh whole source/static-result review is pending. This draft follows PR228; merging requires its parent to reach main and the exact checked tree to match.


### Current source and result review

The 3.888-second check passed: 24 context pins, 31 links, 11 shell syntax blocks and patch dry-run. Installation, package build and all documented runtime commands remain UNRUN. The review retains the stated workspace, shell, UTF-8 and session-lifetime limits. Exactly two documentation files change; financial-prefix work is excluded.

The exact published stack still requires parent delivery and verified main-tree equality before merge. No wider EARS, native or target exit is closed by this PR.
